fr_html: Si l'un et l'autre ne sont pas d'accord dans chacun de ces cas sur l'attitude à prendre, la Cour décide.
en_html: In the event of the President and the member not agreeing as to the course to be adopted in any such case, the matter shall be settled by the decision of the Court.
